caso.texto:
At Atlas, operations wants less rework, finance predictable cost and IT access control. The rep promised integration to IT but told operations no workflow change was needed. The offer exports files, not automatic integration. Implementation agreement is absent.

A US buyer includes an outside IT managed-service provider and a finance approver who has not attended the demo. The sponsor cannot waive security review or approve an annual commitment alone.

projeto.instrucoes: Prepare three 90-second presentations with consistent facts, a role map and conflict summary; propose a criteria discussion rather than announce consensus.
projeto.gabarito: Correct the integration promise and explain export limits. Operations checks added work, IT access and file handling, finance total cost and effort. Record missing agreement and involve owners. Adaptation changes emphasis, not capability.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
